name: Two Knights Defense — Ulvestad Variation
description: After 4.Ng5 d5 5.exd5, Black plays the bold 5...b5 — the Ulvestad Variation — offering a pawn to keep White's bishop busy. After 6.Bf1 Nd4 7.c3 Nxd5 8.Ne4, White plants a powerful knight in the center while Black battles for piece activity and compensation for the sacrificed material.

lines.name: Two Knights Defense — Ulvestad Variation
lines.description: After 5...b5, Black offers a pawn to deflect White's bishop back to f1. Black plays the aggressive 6...Nd4, centralizing a knight on an outpost. After 7.c3 Nxd5 8.Ne4, the position is sharp with White establishing a powerful central knight and Black fighting for compensation with active piece play.
